messages:
meera: Heads up — starting helios-80b-v1 onboarding. weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/helios/80b/v1/ but the shard filenames are `part-0000.pt` style (not the usual `shard_00.pt`) so the loader manifest needs to handle both. Also spotted tokenizer quirk: empty prompt produces a leading <s> token which shifts positions. Can folks do a quick config + mem sanity check?

alex: I can take the weights path/manifest changes. Quick note: the checkpoint dtype looks like 4bit-gptq in the metadata but the loader was falling back to float32 for KV buffers. I'll add an explicit `kv_cache_dtype: float16` option to avoid float32 blowup.

sam: I'll run a smoke load with long context after alex updates manifest. Proposed test: seq_len=65536, batch=1, beam=1, attention window full. Expect KV mem ~ layers * heads * seq_len * head_dim; need headroom.

ben: tokenizer note — helios tokenizer has two special tokens: <s> (id=1) and <pad> (id=0). The model expects generation to start after a single <s>, so if the SDK prepends another <s> we get off-by-one KV indexing. I can add a defensive strip in tokenization layer.

meera: good catch ben. alex, when you update manifest, can you also surface a small config snippet we can use for the smoke test? put it in repo under infra/model-manifests/helios-80b-v1/config.yaml so sam can point CI at it.

alex: dropping config snippet here for smoke run:
```
model: helios-80b-v1
weights_manifest: s3://redwood-models/helios/80b/v1/manifest.json
max_seq_len: 65536
kv_cache:
  layout: per_layer_contiguous
  dtype: float16
  packed: true
allocator:
  reserved_bytes: 8GB  # headroom for rolling attention buffers
runtime_flags:
  force_quant_backend: gptq
```

alex: also added a minimal manifest shim that maps `part-0000.pt` -> shard naming we expect. pushed to my branch: github.com/redwood/infra/+/alex/helios-manifest-fix

sam: starting smoke now. CI job: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/helios-smoke/345 started. will report OOMs / perf numbers.

ci-bot: build #345 queued -> running. logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/helios-smoke/345/logs

sam: quick update — initial run reached token step ~10240 then OOM in kv_alloc at layer 28. stack shows allocation tried to allocate float32 buffer despite config.

ben: any chance the runtime cache allocator ignores `kv_cache.dtype` for some legacy models? I remember a fallback path when weight dtype != kv dtype.

alex: hmm — I missed one spot where we cast KV scratch buffers from `torch.empty(..., dtype=torch.float32)` for some ops. I'll patch to respect `kv_cache.dtype`. PR incoming.

meera: score — alex, can you include a quick test that asserts dtype of KV buffers during a minimal forward? sam, after patch please rerun the same smoke. If still OOM, we can try lowering max_seq_len to 32768 as contingency.

alex: on it. adding unit that creates kv for seq_len=1024 and checks dtype==torch.float16. will link PR in 10m.

sam: ack. re-run queued after PR.

ci-bot: PR #602 opened by alex: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/602 — "respect kv_cache.dtype for scratch buffers"

sam: rerun smoke after merge. CI job #346 created. logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/helios-smoke/346/logs

sam: good news — run completed to seq_len=20480 without OOM, memory peak ~142GB (on 80GB GPU with pooling across two GPUs). Still seeing perf uplift when `packed: true` enabled.

ben: great. followups: (1) tokenizer strip change in PR #47, (2) manifest shim to be promoted to canonical manifest, (3) add reserved_bytes comment to ops docs so infra teams know headroom requirements.

meera: nice work. next steps: alex merge PRs, ben open tokenizer PR, sam run full 65k-run in staging if infra ok. I'll coordinate Dedicated owners for capacity ticket. Thanks everyone :rocket:
